title: Design an API as a product
summary: An API is a product for developers. Design it to be easy to understand, consistent, well documented and stable.

beginner: Start from the tasks developers need to complete.
Agree simple, consistent naming and patterns.
Write the documentation and examples before building.
Test the design with a few developers.
Plan how you will change it later without breaking users.
intermediate: Design from developer tasks with consistent patterns.
Document first and test with developers.
experienced: Measure adoption and time to first successful call.
Manage breaking changes with clear timelines.

toolExamples.github: Review the API specification as a pull request.
toolExamples.gitlab: Keep the API specification and docs in the repository.
